scope: One posthoc detector-space diagnostic of existing V2E2-0235 discovery evidence. It measures conformity to a local trace-plus-background model, not photon/charge attribution.

fixed_geometry.interpretation: Prior registration has strong local support. Keep the accepted header-polynomial trace and orientation fixed; do not recenter, shift or widen the template from the target residual.

scientific_guardrails.requirement: Shared trace templates and any shared background training must use rows disjoint from heldout controls and the central target; include smoothing/interpolation support in that accounting. Choose control positions by frozen coordinates, not residual quality. Apply identical parameterization/masks/fit rules to target and controls, while allowing their fitted amplitude/background coefficients to differ.

Follow the accepted trace polynomial as dispersion varies, rather than one constant detector column throughout the flanks. Retain fixed left-trained and right-trained template predictions as sensitivity diagnostics, without selecting whichever fits the target best or adjusting the target trace.

Retain detector-grid target/control images and signed residuals. If fractional-pixel interpolation is used, document its operator and phase; it spreads compact deposits and correlates neighboring samples. Resampled pixel concentration is not an independent-pixel charge signature.

Preserve signed OLS coefficients, fitted backgrounds and residuals; do not clip negative backgrounds or residuals to zero. Predeclare normalization denominators and mark zero/tiny or otherwise invalid denominators unavailable. Positive-part summaries, if used, must be explicitly named and accompanied by negative-part summaries.

An OLS intercept makes the total signed residual approximately zero by construction. Do not divide an off-trace residual sum by that signed total. Distinguish bounded L1 spatial concentration, such as sum(abs(residual)) outside a fixed band divided by sum(abs(residual)) over the ROI, from residual-to-signal magnitude, which can exceed one. Neither is a photon or charge fraction.

A free trace amplitude per dispersion row can absorb trace-aligned contamination. Conversely a compact residual may reflect template mismatch, curvature, interpolation or background errors. A small residual does not prove photons; a large residual does not establish an artifact-only origin. Photon/charge mixtures remain possible.
Record the design rank and conditioning for the frozen trace/background basis. Avoid a target-selected extra basis term, target-fitted shift or alternate mask that removes the compact feature.

Report fitted intensity, background and local noise context for target and controls. Equal geometry does not equalize noise or line slope; unweighted raw-ADU residuals grow with intensity-dependent noise. Control ranks are descriptive model-adequacy context, not calibrated p-values or an origin classifier.
Controls share the same exposure and order; only order50 covers this event. They are not independent replication. Do not count control rows or resampled neighboring pixels as independent events.

Retain failed/unavailable diagnostics, close the frozen scope after the specified target and controls, and keep the original U adjudication. Do not alter the extraction, select another exposure or expand the control search because the result is inconvenient.

expected_scientific_product: Signed detector-space data/model/residual maps, fixed left/right template sensitivity, target-versus-heldout-control metric table with brightness/denominator/rank diagnostics, and an explicit statement of whether model inadequacy is localized. No physical-origin label or statistical significance is implied.
prior_adjudication: Compact asymmetric patch below and left of the predicted trace; short multi-row excess allowed possible charge contamination or a photon/charge mixture. Root retained U after disagreement between reviewers.
review_boundary: This records protocol requirements before new-phase raw-array access. Exact implementation approval is still pending; no raw values or new-phase measured results were inspected.
